headline: Closing the window keeps the app; quitting asks first
highlights: \u{2318}Q pauses on one plain question when quitting would cost something. A session that isn't saved to a package offers Save and Quit / Quit Anyway / Cancel — Save and Quit writes the same .klsession package as \u{21E7}\u{2318}S — and a build, export, package save or import still mid-flight asks before being abandoned. A quit with nothing to lose stays instant.

\u{2318}W closes the window and only the window now. The app keeps running, the session survives untouched, and a click on the Dock icon brings the window back exactly as it was — closing the window used to quit the whole app on the spot. Both behaviors come from one shared piece of the kit, the same window-and-quit standard across the KL's Tools family.
